posts.zh:
dsh-vision-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给模型目录装上「图片输入」勾选框，自定义模型声明后可直接收图；附带可选的 BYO 视觉中继。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c47df993920174219f45.html
posts.en:
dsh-vision-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Installs an image-input checkbox into the Models catalog so a custom model can declare image input and receive images directly; includes an optional BYO vision relay.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c47df993920174219f45.html
